title: Excess Wear Charge Computation for Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns
content:
The excess wear charge on a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract starts from the wear assessed on the return inspection on file, that is the total excess wear the inspection assessed under the Kestrel wear standard. Where more than one return inspection is on file the one with the latest inspection date is used, and of two dated the same day the one recorded first.

## The computation

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Wear forgiveness | The wear waiver cap for the contract's tier, from the return option schedule |
| Chargeable wear | The wear assessed less the wear forgiveness, never below zero |
| Excess wear charge | The chargeable wear, rounded to the cent |

**Order of the computation.** Replacements of the wear forgiveness are made first and proration of it second, a prorated forgiveness being rounded to the cent; the wear forgiveness and every wear credit that applies are then subtracted together from the wear assessed, the chargeable wear that remains never falls below zero, and any share of it that applies is taken last, rounded to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Tier wear waiver cap | Wear assessed | Chargeable wear | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 250.00 | USD 1,180.00 | USD 930.00 | USD 930.00 |
| USD 0.00 | USD 640.00 | USD 640.00 | USD 640.00 |
| USD 750.00 | USD 300.00 | USD 0.00 (floor) | USD 0.00 |
